name: Analyze local project
goal: Analyze a local project and return a verified architecture summary.

name: Clone repository
goal: Clone a repository and verify the working tree exists and is complete.

name: Install dependencies
goal: Install project dependencies reproducibly and verify the resolved environment.

name: Start project
goal: Start an application and verify its service/readiness endpoint is reachable.

name: Diagnose build failure
goal: Identify the root cause of a deterministic build failure.

name: Repair build failure
goal: Repair a build failure and verify the build succeeds afterward.

name: Implement code change
goal: Implement a small code change and verify the requested behavior.

name: Run tests
goal: Run the canonical test suite and correctly interpret its result.

name: Write missing test
goal: Add a reproducible test for a specified behavior and verify it executes.

name: Analyze website
goal: Open a website, extract requested information, and verify the source state.

name: Multi-step browser workflow
goal: Complete a deterministic multi-step browser workflow and verify the final state.

name: Launch Windows application
goal: Launch the requested Windows application and verify the correct process/window is active.

name: Operate Windows UI
goal: Operate a Windows UI element and verify the resulting UI state.

name: Create and modify file
goal: Create and modify a file and verify its final contents.

name: Recover from agent failure
goal: Recover from a controlled agent/runtime failure without losing task intent.

name: Resume after application restart
goal: Restart Agent OS and resume the task from durable state without duplicate execution.

name: Gate critical action
goal: Detect a critical action and require the configured permission decision before execution.

name: Reject false completion
goal: Detect a false success claim and refuse task completion without valid evidence.

name: Multi-agent delegation
goal: Delegate dependent subtasks to multiple agents and integrate their verified outputs.

name: Repository to verified running application
goal: Clone, analyze, repair if required, build, start and verify a repository end to end.
